narrative.overview: A quiet desk late at night with one audit file open. The room is dark so the numbers can be bright.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only; no light theme exists.
Flat, hairline-separated sheets, with no shadows.
White for numbers and primary actions, gold for a single point of attention.
Green and red mean up and down, and are never decoration.
Percentages may be public; rupee amounts obey Privacy Mode.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: Gold marks one thing per card. If two things are gold, neither is the point.

rules.name: The Direction Only Rule
rules.body: Green and red say up or down. They never mean brand, selection or series identity, and a direction is never told by colour alone: a sign or arrow goes with it.

rules.name: The Number Comes First Rule
rules.body: Within a card the figure is the heaviest thing. Words explain it and stay lighter.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If something must sit above the page, it is a bottom sheet or a dialog with a lighter sheet colour.

dos: Do show a date on anything that can go stale.
Do write "—" for a missing number.
Do say on the card what a figure is not, when it could be misread.
Do use the tokens in lib/core/theme instead of a colour literal.
Do keep touch targets at 48px or more.
donts: Don't add shadows or decorative gradients to surfaces.
Don't use gold for a second thing on the same card.
Don't use green or red to mean anything except direction.
Don't put rupee amounts on a shareable card.
Don't add a light theme without replacing this document.
